name: contract-wallet-owner-signature
description: The settler is a contract wallet whose owner (Hardhat #1) signed the digest: a 65-byte signature that recovers to the owner, not to message.from. The wallet vouches for it, so the authorization is proved.

name: approved-hash-wallet
description: The settler is a contract wallet that accepts one opaque 96-byte signature, as contract-signature.json carries. Not recoverable offline; proved by the wallet's answer.

name: empty-signature-approved-by-wallet
description: An empty signature is the wallet's business: a wallet that approved the digest on chain answers for it, and the token would pass the same bytes to it.

name: eoa-settler
description: The settler has no code, so its key must have signed; settler-signed.json is signed by it. One code read, no isValidSignature call.

name: wallet-owner-differs
description: The wallet answers, but its owner is someone else, so it returns a value that is not the magic value.

name: wallet-reverts
description: The wallet reverts on the signature, as a Safe does on one it does not accept. A revert is the contract's answer, not an unreadable chain.

name: wallet-trusts-another-caller
description: The wallet only answers a caller it trusts, and the token is not that caller. The call must be made with msg.sender set to the token (the destination's verifyingContract), so this reverts.

name: wallet-approves-another-signature
description: The wallet approves a different signature than the document carries.

name: wallet-returns-nothing
description: The call succeeds with no return data.

expect.error_contains: returned 0x, not the ERC-1271 magic value

name: wallet-returns-bare-selector
description: The magic value without its padding to a word: four bytes, not the 32 the token compares.

expect.error_contains: returned 0x1626ba7e, not the ERC-1271 magic value

name: wallet-returns-right-aligned-selector
description: The selector right-aligned in the word, which is bytes32(uint32), not the bytes4 the token compares.

name: wallet-returns-true
description: A wallet that answers like isApprovedSigner, with a bool.

name: wallet-returns-magic-word-with-a-nonzero-tail
description: The magic selector followed by 27 zero bytes and 01: a 32-byte word whose first four bytes are the selector and which is not the magic word. A binding that compares only the leading four bytes accepts it; the token compares the whole word.

name: wallet-returns-magic-word-and-more
description: A 64-byte answer whose first word is the magic word. The token requires at least 32 bytes and compares the first word (Circle's SignatureChecker and OpenZeppelin 4.9's both read result.length >= 32), so extra return data is accepted; a binding that demands exactly 32 bytes refuses it.

name: wallet-returns-invalid-value
description: The ERC-1271 failure value, 0xffffffff.

name: code-read-fails
description: The chain cannot be read, so the document is neither accepted nor refused as wrong: a distinct, retryable error.

name: call-fails
description: The signer has code but the isValidSignature call itself fails to run.

name: no-code-another-key-signed
description: No code at the settler, so only its key can sign, and another key did.

name: no-code-contract-shaped-signature
description: No code at the settler and a signature that is not 65 bytes: nothing a key produced, and no contract to answer for it.

name: no-code-empty-signature
description: No code at the settler and an empty signature.

name: eip7702-delegate-refuses-the-key-signature
description: The settler's account carries an EIP-7702 delegation, which is code, and its own key signed the digest. A token that tests code first (Circle's SignatureChecker, USDC) sends the signature to the delegate, so a delegate that refuses it refuses the authorization even though the key signed, and reading the code first reaches that verdict. A token that tries the key first (OpenZeppelin 4.9's, PYUSD) would execute this authorization; this binding refuses it, the safe direction, and does not close that divergence.

name: eip7702-delegate-approves
description: The same delegated account whose delegate approves.

name: offline-rule-fails-before-any-chain-read
description: A document that fails an offline rule (expiry) costs no chain read, whatever the wallet would say.

name: signer-not-settler-before-any-chain-read
description: An account the quote does not name is never asked about.

name: domain-not-destination-before-any-chain-read
description: A document signed under another chain's domain is refused offline, before the chain is read.
